review_limits: No paper draft or slide deck was supplied; claims-vs-code review was limited to checking consistency between MATCHING/linked_groups_socio.do, its generated markdown header, and upstream code/results in the repository.

The Stata pipeline and external datasets ($REP_SNU/enum_date/DATA/INTERMEDIATE/temp_tgt.dta) could not be executed or inspected directly in this read-only review environment; runtime properties were inferred from source code and committed repnum outputs.
structured_output.summary: The uncommitted changes in MATCHING/linked_groups_socio.do (and its companion brief) are clean across all four review dimensions. Both defects from the prior iteration—referencing an unsaved target variable in temp_tgt.dta and recoding incnonwg==1 to missing when computing within-group category shares—have been resolved and gated with exact assertions against MATCHING/results/create_figures_SSHA2025_tgt.tex.

verified_clean.evidence: MATCHING/linked_groups_socio.do:30-43 asserts _N==51036859, linked_before mean 22.8142938812124%, linked_after mean 25.5382957638518%, binary domains for linked_before/linked_after/congruent, and reconstructed target = 1 - congruent mean 28.2473163170171%, matching CODE/create_figures_SSHA2025.do:73,119,138 and MATCHING/results/create_figures_SSHA2025_tgt.tex:8-10,22 to within 1e-9.
verified_clean.item: Input dataset gate and reconstruction of target = 1 - congruent from temp_tgt.dta

verified_clean.evidence: MATCHING/linked_groups_socio.do:46-63 matches the recodes in CODE/create_figures_SSHA2025.do:317-352 for all 15 socio-demographic variables while changing incnonwg from (1 9=.) to (0 9=.) so both <=$50 (1) and >$50 (2) categories are retained for within-group shares, and adding the missing label for incnonwg==1 at MATCHING/linked_groups_socio.do:102.
verified_clean.item: Socio-demographic recodes and category completeness for within-group share calculations

verified_clean.evidence: In MATCHING/results/create_figures_SSHA2025_tgt.tex:23, \socioGroups is 65, which equals the exact number of labeled categories in CODE/label_socio_demo.do across the 15 variables in Figure 4 (after excluding incnonwg==1 and migrate5==4). Thus, in temp_tgt.dta, no unrecoded residual codes exist for any of the 15 variables, and all 67 categories in MATCHING/linked_groups_socio.do receive labels at lines 101-103.
verified_clean.item: Absence of unrecoded IPUMS codes and completeness of category labels in temp_tgt.dta

verified_clean.evidence: MATCHING/linked_groups_socio.do:65-78 partitions all records into grp 1..4 (Both, After only, Neither, Before only) after asserting linked_before and linked_after are in {0,1}, checks N1+N2+N3+N4 == _N, and computes category shares at lines 83-96 over non-missing denominators (!missing(v)) with levelsof excluding missing values.
verified_clean.item: Link-status group partition and missing-value handling in numerators and denominators

summary.description: Two to four sentences. The overall state of the reviewed work and the single most important thing to fix. No preamble.

dimensions_reviewed.description: Which scope dimensions were actually reviewed in this run.

findings.description: Defects and concerns, ordered most severe first. Empty if none. Do not pad with stylistic observations.

severity.description: blocker: a reported result is wrong. major: a referee would demand it. minor: real but survivable. nit: cosmetic.

confidence.description: verified: traced in the source. likely: strongly implied but depends on unseen data. speculative: a question, not an established defect.

title.description: One line, stating the defect itself, not its category.

location.description: path:line, or path:line-line. Several may be comma-separated. Required: a finding without a location is not a finding.

what_the_code_does.description: Precisely what the code computes, quoting the relevant expression. Contrast with what it was evidently intended to compute.

why_it_matters.description: The consequence for a number or claim in the paper. If there is no consequence, the severity is nit.

how_to_check.description: A concrete command, tabulation, or count the author can run to confirm or refute this in minutes.

suggested_fix.description: The change, specific enough to act on. Do not apply it yourself.

verified_clean.description: Things explicitly checked that were fine. This is what makes a short findings list trustworthy rather than lazy.

evidence.description: How it was confirmed, with path:line where applicable.

review_limits.description: What this review could NOT establish: data not readable, pipeline not runnable, paper text unavailable, Stata semantics not verifiable by reading. Be explicit; silence here reads as false assurance.
